description:
Full intelligence for a single CVE: CVSS, KEV status, EPSS, CISA SSVC
(exploitation/automatable/technical_impact), P1-P4 priority with rationale,
affected products/versions, Debian/Ubuntu/Alpine fixed builds per release
(`distro_fixes`), and (live) public-exploit signal.

For a LIST (a scan's findings, a vulnerability review): pass `cve_ids` (up to 50) instead
and get one compact card per CVE with the exploitation evidence only: KEV (+ date added,
ransomware use), SSVC, EPSS, Metasploit modules, the danger signal when KEV is silent, CVSS
vector. Whether each applies to a given host is a separate verify_cve_claim with that
host's product/build.

Args:
    cve_id: e.g. "CVE-2025-12345".
    include_poc: also query GitHub for public PoC/exploit repos (live; single CVE only).
    cve_ids: a list of CVE ids for compact list mode (max 50).
name: enrich_cve
title: Enrich a CVE
